import sys, struct, plistlib, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from harness import *
from protocols import adb_packet

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 3)
T = ['2001:db8:1:1200::%d' % i for i in (1, 2, 3)]
EX = '2001:db8:1:1200::9'
S = {'web': 'tcp', 'dev': 'adb', 'mob': 'sync'}
CN = b64(adb_packet(0x4e584e43, 0x01020304, 1, b'banner'))

def frame(key, value, binary=False):
    body = plistlib.dumps({'Key': key, 'Request': 'GetValue', 'Value': value},
                          fmt=plistlib.FMT_BINARY if binary else plistlib.FMT_XML)
    return struct.pack('>I', len(body)) + body

SYNC = b64(frame('ProductVersion', '17.0') + frame('ProductName', 'iPhone'))
SYNCBIN = b64(frame('ProductVersion', '17.1', True) + frame('ProductName', 'Pad', True))

# four queries, request at each
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 30, 'put', 'home', 30, '0/i2', T[1], T[1], 'echo'),
        icmp('c', 0, 60, 'put', 'home', 60, '0/i3', T[2], T[2], 'echo')]
requests = [request('r%d' % i, at, 'home', T[i], 'web') for i, at in enumerate((10, 40, 70, 70))]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10, 40, 70, 95], [make_capture(rows)], requests=requests))
ok &= check('four queries snapshots', [s['at'] for s in got['snapshots']], [10, 40, 70, 95])
ok &= check('four queries internal', [s['leases'][0]['internal'] for s in got['snapshots']],
            [[T[0]], [T[0], T[1]], [T[0], T[1], T[2]], [T[0], T[1], T[2]]])
ok &= check('four queries active', [r['active'] for r in got['active_requests']],
            [True, True, True, False])

# protocol errors aggregate across targets
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i2', T[1], T[1], 'echo'),
        app('x', 0, 2, 'put', 'home', 2, T[0], 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(b'junk')),
        app('y', 0, 2, 'put', 'home', 2, T[1], 'open', 'dev', 0, b64(b'junk'))]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('errors aggregate', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][1]['protocol_errors'], 2)

# binary plist accepted
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo'),
        app('x', 0, 2, 'put', 'home', 2, T[0], 'open', 'mob', 0, SYNCBIN)]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('binary plist', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][2]['internal_open'], [T[0]])

# xml plist accepted
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo'),
        app('x', 0, 2, 'put', 'home', 2, T[0], 'open', 'mob', 0, SYNC)]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('xml plist', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][2]['internal_open'], [T[0]])

# external witness after the event makes the app row unbound
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 8, '0/i1', T[0], EX, 'echo'),
        app('x', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 4, EX, 'open', 'web', 0, ''),
        app('y', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 9, EX, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('external causality', got['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'], 1)
ok &= check('external eligible', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['external_open'], [EX])

# canary echo only at a later query flips the state
import hashlib, ipaddress
net = int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8:1:1200::/64').network_address)
can = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(('demo\nhome\n2001:db8:1:1200::/64').encode()).digest()[:8], 'big') | (1 << 63)
CAN = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(net + can))
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 50, 'put', 'home', 50, '0/c', CAN, CAN, 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10, 60], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('canary timing', [s['leases'][0]['state'] for s in got['snapshots']],
            ['usable', 'alias'])

# multiple services reported for every lease
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture([icmp('a', 0, 1, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T[0], T[0], 'echo')])]))
ok &= check('service ids', [s['id'] for s in got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services']],
            ['dev', 'mob', 'web'])

# no services at all
got, _ = run(campaign([L], {}, [10], []))
ok &= check('no services', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'], [])

# 4 queries is the maximum
ok &= check('five queries', run(campaign([L], S, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], []))[0], {'error': 'invalid'})

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
